Rashi on Arakhin 12a:10:1.hebrew: אי הכי - דבשנת ט"ו לחורבן הוי ההיא נבואה, כ"ו לגלות יהויכין הואי:
Rashi on Arakhin 12a:10:1.english: If so - That that prophecy was in the fifteenth year of the destruction — it was the twenty-sixth [year] of the exile of Jehoiachin.

Rashi on Arakhin 12a:10:2.english: As the Master said: They were exiled - Israel [were exiled] with Jehoiachin.

Rashi on Arakhin 12a:10:3.english: In seven - In the seventh year of the subjugation of Jehoiakim.

Rashi on Arakhin 12a:10:4.hebrew: גלו בשמונה - כלומר, שאותה גלות היתה בשנה שמינית למלכות נבוכדנצר, דשנה שניה למלכותו כיבש יהויקים, כדמפרש לקמן:
Rashi on Arakhin 12a:10:4.english: They were exiled in the eighth [year] - That is to say, that that exile was in the eighth year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar, for in the second year of his reign he subjugated Jehoiakim, as [the Gemara] explains below.

Rashi on Arakhin 12a:11:1.hebrew: גלו בי"ח - עם צדקיהו, והיא היתה חרבות ירושלים; והיא היתה שנת י"ח לכיבוש יהויקים, והיא שנת י"ט לנבוכדנצר:
Rashi on Arakhin 12a:11:1.english: They were exiled in the eighteenth [year] - [This was] with Zedekiah, and that was the destruction of Jerusalem; and it was the eighteenth year from the subjugation of Jehoiakim, and it was the nineteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.

Rashi on Arakhin 12a:12:1.hebrew: משב ועד תמני סרי - משנה שביעית, שהוא גלות יחזקאל, עד תמני סרי, שהוא חורבן הבית — חד סרי, לבהדי שתא דגלה בה יחזקאל, ולבר משנת החורבן, דמנינו לה בהדי הנך דמחורבן ועד יובל. וחמיסר דמחורבן ועד יובל, עם שנת החורבן ושנת היובל — אשתכח דכ"ו הוו מהשתא דגלו בה ועד יובל. והיכי אמר יחזקאל: ״בעשרים וחמש לגלותנו״ היה יובל? וס"ד דבהדי שתא דגלו קאמר:
Rashi on Arakhin 12a:12:1.english: From seven until eighteen - From the seventh year, which was the exile of Ezekiel, until the eighteenth [year], which was the destruction of the Temple — [is] eleven [years], including the year in which Ezekiel was exiled, and excluding the year of the destruction, as we counted it along with those [years] from the destruction until the Jubilee. And fifteen [years] from the destruction until the Jubilee, including [both] the year of the destruction and the year of the Jubilee — it turns out that there were twenty-six [years] from the year in which they were exiled until the Jubilee. And how could Ezekiel say: “In the twenty-fifth [year] of our exile” was the Jubilee? And [the Gemara] initially assumed that he said [this] including the year they were exiled.

Rashi on Arakhin 12a:13:1.hebrew: ולדידך - דבעית למימני לשנת החורבן בהנך ארבעה עשר, מי ניחא:
Rashi on Arakhin 12a:13:1.english: And according to you - [You] who wish to count the year of the destruction among those fourteen [years], does it work out well?

Rashi on Arakhin 12a:13:2.hebrew: מכדי גלו נמי בי"ט - דס"ד דהאי מתרץ דג' גליות הוו — דהא דתני גלו בי"ח ובי"ט הוו שני גליות — וסבר דבשמונה עשר הוה חורבן. וכי מנית נמי ארביסר לבהדי שנת חורבן ושנת היובל, משכחת לה עשרין ושית בגלות יהויכין, שהיתה בשנת שבע, ולבהדי שתא דגלו בה:
Rashi on Arakhin 12a:13:2.english: Now, they were also exiled in the nineteenth [year] - For it entered the mind of this answerer that there were three exiles — as that which [the baraita] taught, "They were exiled in the eighteenth and in the nineteenth," were two [separate] exiles — and he held that the destruction was in the eighteenth [year]. And when you also count fourteen [years] together with the year of the destruction and the year of the Jubilee, you find twenty-six [years] for the exile of Jehoiachin, which was in the seventh year, [when counted] together with the year in which they were exiled.

Rashi on Arakhin 12a:13:3.english: Rather, what have you to say - [Regarding] that which Ezekiel said, "In the twenty-fifth [year] of our exile."

Rashi on Arakhin 12a:13:4.english: Excluding the year in which they were exiled - [Namely,] Jehoiachin and Ezekiel.

Rashi on Arakhin 12a:14:1.hebrew: מ"מ תשסרי לרבינא קשיא - דהא ודאי בגלות האחרון היה החורבן. וכיון דאמר רבינא חמיסרי שנים עד היובל, ומגלות יהויכין ועד שנת חורבן, שהוא בי"ט, הוו חד סרי — לבר משתא דגלו בה ולבר שנת החורבן — וחמיסרי, הא עשרין ושית:
Rashi on Arakhin 12a:14:1.english: In any case, [the] nineteenth [year] is difficult for Ravina - For certainly the destruction was in the final exile. And since Ravina said [that there were] fifteen years until the Jubilee, and from the exile of Jehoiachin until the year of the destruction, which was in the nineteenth [year], there are eleven [years] — excluding the year in which they were exiled and excluding the year of the destruction — and [with those] fifteen, behold, [that is] twenty-six.

Rashi on Arakhin 12a:15:1.hebrew: מי סברת ג' גליות הוו - הש"ס הוא דקא מתרץ, דהאי דאמרן לעיל "גלו נמי בתישסרי" לאו מלתא היא, דחד גלות הוה; דבשמונה עשר לכיבוש יהויקים הוו חרבות ירושלים, שהיא תשעה עשר לנבוכדנצר. הלכך, משב ועד תשעה עשר — לבר משתא דגלו בה יהויכין ויחזקאל, ולבר שנת החורבן — וט"ו עם שנת החורבן ושנת היובל, הרי כ"ה:
Rashi on Arakhin 12a:15:1.english: Do you think there were three exiles? - It is the Gemara that is answering that what we said above, "They were also exiled in the nineteenth," is not correct, for it was one exile; as in the eighteenth [year] from the subjugation of Jehoiakim was the destruction of Jerusalem, which was the nineteenth [year] of Nebuchadnezzar. Therefore, from [year] seven until [year] nineteen — excluding the year in which Jehoiachin and Ezekiel were exiled, and excluding the year of the destruction — and fifteen [years] including the year of the destruction and the year of the Jubilee, behold, [there are] twenty-five.

Rashi on Arakhin 12a:16:1.english: As the Master said - In Seder Olam.

Rashi on Arakhin 12a:1:1.hebrew: נסכים הבאין בפני עצמן - כגון שהביאו היום קרבן ציבור ולא הביאו נסכים עמו, והביאום למחר, דאמר מר (מנחות דף מד:): מנחתם ונסכיהם בלילה, מנחתם ונסכיהם אפי' למחר:
Rashi on Arakhin 12a:1:1.english: Libations that come by themselves - For example, where they brought a communal offering today and did not bring libations with it, and they brought them the next day; as the Master said (Menachot 44b): "Their meal-offering and their libations [may be brought] at night; their meal-offering and their libations [may be brought] even the next day."

Rashi on Arakhin 12a:1:2.english: Eating and drinking - A sacrifice and libations.

Rashi on Arakhin 12a:3:1.hebrew: והא תני רב מרי בריה דרב כהנא - לעיל, דאין עולת נדבה טעונה שיר, שהרי אין זמנה קבוע:
Rashi on Arakhin 12a:3:1.english: But didn't Rav Mari, son of Rav Kahana, teach - Above, that a voluntary burnt offering does not require song, for its time is not fixed.

Rashi on Arakhin 12a:4:1.english: And can you understand - That they recited [it] for the sake of [the] song on Sunday?

Rashi on Arakhin 12a:5:1.hebrew: נפיק מיניה חורבא - דאתי למימר: כי היכי דנסכים הבאים בפני עצמן רשות, נסכים הבאין עם הקרבן נמי רשות:
Rashi on Arakhin 12a:5:1.english: A mishap would result from it - For [people] will come to say: Just as [the song for] libations that are brought on their own is optional, [the song for] libations that are brought with the offering is also optional.

Rashi on Arakhin 12a:7:1.hebrew: לגלותנו - גלות יהויכין והחרש והמסגר, ויחזקאל היה מהם:
Rashi on Arakhin 12a:7:1.english: Of our exile - The exile of Jehoiachin and the craftsmen and the smiths, and Ezekiel was among them.

Rashi on Arakhin 12a:7:2.hebrew: יובל - ראש השנה שלה ביום הכפורים, דתוקעין ב"ד בשופר ונפטרים עבדים לבתיהן ושדות חוזרות לבעליהן, ואז נראית שהיא יובל. אלמא, שנת היובל הוה בשנת י"ד לחורבן הבית, וקס"ד בהדי שתא דחורבן קאמר, ויובל הוא לעולם במוצאי שביעית, דשנת מ"ט שביעית היא:
Rashi on Arakhin 12a:7:2.english: Jubilee - Its New Year is on Yom Kippur, for the court sounds the shofar, and slaves are released to their homes, and fields return to their owners, and then it is evident that it is a Jubilee. It follows that the Jubilee year was in the fourteenth year after the destruction of the Temple, and [the Gemara] initially assumes that it means together with [i.e., including] the year of the destruction, and a Jubilee is always at the conclusion of a Sabbatical year, for the forty-ninth year is a Sabbatical year.

Rashi on Arakhin 12a:8:1.hebrew: ואי ס"ד במוצאי שביעי' חרוב - היכי משכחת לה י"ד, לבהדי דתיהוי במוצאי שביעית? אחד בשבוע וכו':
Rashi on Arakhin 12a:8:1.english: And if it enters your mind [that] it was destroyed in the year following a Sabbatical [year] - How can you find fourteen [years], so that it will be in the year following a Sabbatical [year]? '[From] the first [year] of the Sabbatical cycle...', etc.

Rashi on Arakhin 12a:9:1.hebrew: אחר שנה - וכי חשבת ט"ו שנים משנת היובל למפרע, משכחת חורבן במוצאי שביעית, שהיא שנת ל"ו למנין יובל זה:
Rashi on Arakhin 12a:9:1.english: After the year - And when you count fifteen years retroactively from the Jubilee year, you find [that] the destruction [occurred] in the year after a Sabbatical [year], which is the thirty-sixth year according to the count of this Jubilee [cycle].

Tosafot on Arakhin 12a:10:1.hebrew: אי הכי - דהוה שנת ט"ו לחורבן, עשרין וה' הויין? כ"ו הויין! דאמר מר: "גלו בז'" — פי' בז' לכיבוש יהויקים, שכיבש בד' למלכותו, והוא מלך י"א שנה; ובאותה שנה הרג יהויקים, והמליך יהויכין בנו ג' חדשים, ולתקופת השנה באותה שנה הגלהו לבבל והחרש והמסגר, ואז היה גלות דיחזקאל:
Tosafot on Arakhin 12a:10:1.english: "If so" - [Meaning,] that it was the fifteenth year of the destruction: are they twenty-five [years]? They are twenty-six! For the Master said: "They were exiled in the seventh [year]" — meaning, in the seventh [year] of the subjugation of Jehoiakim, whom [Nebuchadnezzar] subjugated in the fourth [year] of his reign, and he reigned for eleven years; and in that [eleventh] year [Nebuchadnezzar] killed Jehoiakim, and made his son Jehoiachin king for three months, and at the turn of the year, in that [same] year, he exiled him to Babylon along with the craftsmen and the smiths, and that was the exile of Ezekiel.

Tosafot on Arakhin 12a:11:1.hebrew: גלו בי"ח - לכיבוש, היינו כשהוכתה העיר:
Tosafot on Arakhin 12a:11:1.english: "They were exiled in the eighteenth [year]" - [This was] from the subjugation [of Jehoiakim]; that is, when the city was smitten.

Tosafot on Arakhin 12a:12:1.hebrew: משבע שגלו בה עד תמניסר שחרבה העיר - בלא תמניסר עצמו, שהוא מנין דט"ו — חדסר, דשנה שביעית שגלו בה היא היתה שנה אחרונה ליהויקים, ושוב מלך צדקיהו י' שנים לפני שנת החורבן, וט"ו — כ"ו הויין. בשלמא אי אמרינן די"ד שנה לחורבן עצמו קאמר — ניחא, די"ד וי"א הם כ"ה; אלא כיון דאמר דהוה שנת ט"ו — קשיא. ומצית לשנויי דשנה שגלו בה היא היתה שנה ראשונה לצדקיהו, וליכא אלא י' שנים מן הגלות עד שנת של חורבן; אלא קים ליה דאינו כן, דהגלות היה באותה שנה שנמנית ליהויקים; א"כ איכא אחד עשר שנה:
Tosafot on Arakhin 12a:12:1.english: "From the seven[th year] in which they were exiled until the eighteen[th year] in which the city was destroyed" - Without [counting] the eighteenth [year] itself, which is [included in] the count of fifteen, [there are] eleven [years]. For the seventh year, in which they were exiled, was the last year of Jehoiakim, and subsequently Zedekiah reigned ten years before the year of the destruction; and [these eleven plus] fifteen are twenty-six. Granted, if we say that [the verse] says fourteen years [counting from] the destruction itself, it works out well, as fourteen and eleven are twenty-five; however, since [Ravina] said that it was the fifteenth year, it is difficult. And you could have answered that the year in which they were exiled was the first year of Zedekiah, and there are only ten years from the exile until the year of the destruction; rather, it was clear to [the Gemara] that this is not so, for the exile occurred in that year that was counted to Jehoiakim; if so, there are eleven years.

Tosafot on Arakhin 12a:13:1.hebrew: ולדידך מי ניחא - מכדי גלו בי"ט שנה, והיינו כשהוכתה העיר; מז' עד י"ט י"ב הוו, וארבסרי — כ"ו הויין. ומצי למיפרך לפי שיטתן, שהיה סבור די"ח וי"ט שני גליות: דא"כ היכי מתוקמא? אי הוכתה בי"ח — לא הוכתה בי"ט! ואין להקפיד, דסוגיא בעלמא הוא, ולמסקנא ניחא:
Tosafot on Arakhin 12a:13:1.english: "And according to you, does it work out well?" - Now, they were exiled in the nineteenth year, and that was when the city was struck; from [year] seven until [year] nineteen is twelve [years], and fourteen [makes] twenty-six. And one could object according to their premise, since he assumed that [years] eighteen and nineteen were two [separate] exiles: for if so, how can it be established? If it was struck in [year] eighteen, it was not struck in [year] nineteen! And one should not be particular [about this], for it is merely a passing discussion, and according to the conclusion, it works out well.

Tosafot on Arakhin 12a:1:1.hebrew: נסכים הבאים בפני עצמן טעונין שירה או לאו - פי': נסכים מקרבן ציבור שלא הקריבו ביומו, ולמחר מקריבין, כדדרשי' (מנחות דף מד:): "ומנחתם" עד עשרה ימים. וליכא לפרושי אם התנדב אדם מנחת נסכים, דאפי' הביאו קרבן חובה — קרבנו אין טעון נסכים. ומיירי ודאי שמקריבה ביום; אבל מקריבה בלילה — [הא] א"ר אלעזר: מה כפרה ביום, אף שירה ביום:
Tosafot on Arakhin 12a:1:1.english: "Libations that come by themselves, do they require song or not?" - Explanation: [This refers to] libations from a communal offering that they did not sacrifice on its day, and they sacrifice [them] on the morrow, as we expound (Menachot 44b): "And their meal offering..." up to ten days. And it cannot be explained [as referring to a case where] a person volunteered a meal offering of libations, for even if they brought an obligatory offering, his offering does not require libations [accompanied by song]. And it certainly deals with [a case where] one sacrifices it by day; but [if] one sacrifices it at night — [surely] Rabbi Elazar said: Just as atonement is by day, so too song is by day.

Tosafot on Arakhin 12a:4:1.hebrew: ותסברא שירה דיומיה לה' - ואי נמי נסכים הבאים בפני עצמן טעונים שירה, היינו שיר של יום שמביאין אותו, ולא שיר שהיה ראוי ביום הבאת קרבן:
Tosafot on Arakhin 12a:4:1.english: "And can you understand [that] it should be the song of that day?" - And even if libations that are brought on their own require song, that would be the song of the day on which they bring it, and not the song that was appropriate on the day the offering was brought.

Tosafot on Arakhin 12a:8:1.english: "From the first [year] of the Sabbatical cycle to the [next] first [year] of the Sabbatical cycle" - [The Gemara] is counting the fifteen years backwards [from the Jubilee].

Tosafot on Arakhin 12a:9:1.hebrew: אמר רבינא - בי"ד אחר שנה שהוכתה העיר, [דהיינו] בשנת ט"ו לחורבן — אז היה יובל:
Tosafot on Arakhin 12a:9:1.english: "Ravina said" - In the fourteenth [year] after the year that the city was smitten, [that is,] in the fifteenth year from the destruction — then it was the Jubilee.
